[CIC-FIXTURE:applied-ai-engineer]
Applied AI Engineer — Harbour Labs (Sydney)

Join our applied AI team to prototype and productise customer-facing assistants.
You will work closely with solution architects and customer success.

Responsibilities
• Deliver applied AI prototypes into production services
• Fine-tune and evaluate models for customer use cases
• Document patterns for reuse across engagements

Requirements
• 3+ years building ML or AI-powered products required
• Python and FastAPI required; Azure OpenAI preferred
• Stakeholder-facing delivery experience preferred

Location & employment
Hybrid Sydney (Barangaroo), 2 days in office. Full-time permanent.
Salary $140,000–$165,000 AUD.

acquisition.title: Applied AI Engineer

identity.summary: AI Engineer applying software engineering discipline to build end-to-end AI applications with Python, FastAPI, Docker, and OpenAI APIs. 3.5 years of commercial enterprise Data Engineering experience, plus independent AI Engineering portfolio work across retrieval systems, operational intelligence, explainable AI, and enterprise decision support. Applies a disciplined AI Engineering methodology — architecture-first design, evidence-based validation, and human-in-the-loop review — to build AI systems with traceable, reviewable outputs for operational decision-making.

experience.title: AI Engineer - Independent Research & Development
highlights: Delivered a portfolio of AI applications spanning retrieval-augmented generation, operational intelligence, explainable diagnostics, and enterprise decision support.
Applied FastAPI, Docker, OpenAI APIs, Git, and PyTest where each portfolio system required them.
Designed architectures that separate deterministic business logic from AI reasoning components.
Published engineering documentation and public demonstrations of working systems.

experience.title: AI Engineering Professional Development and Portfolio Development
highlights: Advanced from Data Engineering foundations into AI Engineering through structured study and increasingly sophisticated engineering projects.
Undertook structured AI Engineering study.
Developed progressively more sophisticated portfolio projects.
Strengthened delivery discipline through testing, documentation, and milestone-driven project execution.

experience.title: Data Engineering Professional Development and Career Transition
highlights: Full-time professional development focused initially on modern Data Engineering platforms after the nbn Australia role.
Developed skills across contemporary data platforms and tools, including Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, and Azure Data Factory.
Built the foundation for subsequent AI Engineering portfolio development.

experience.title: Data Engineer
highlights: Developed and maintained enterprise data pipelines and operational reporting solutions using AWS services, Python, SQL, and Apache NiFi.
Performed SQL transformations, data validation, and production support for geospatial and business-operational datasets.
Worked in Agile delivery teams supporting reliable production data systems with Git and automated testing practices.

experience.title: Data Science Immersive
highlights: Completed the General Assembly Data Science Immersive course.

Gathered data via web scraping of job listings for data-scientist and data-analyst roles in Sydney and Melbourne, evaluating top skills required through predictive modelling and NLP text classification and predicting likely salary offerings.
Cleaned, explored, and analysed a large real-estate dataset for a property sales price and renovation project.

experience.title: Test Analyst
highlights: Returned for a short engagement prior to Data Science study.

experience.title: Test Analyst
highlights: Built Selenium test cases and API test suites for Myki / Public Transport Victoria (PTV) systems as a consultant to PTV.
Conducted mobile and functional testing with Jira.

experience.title: Test Analyst
highlights: Contributed to the main project replacing the outdated POS system for 750 bakeries in 4 countries with a new tablet-based platform.
Designed and implemented an automation framework.
Developed web automation test cases for identified automation scenarios using Selenium WebDriver with Java.
Used the Maven build-management tool and the Jenkins continuous integration tool.
Created and maintained test environments.

experience.title: Test Analyst
highlights: Developed and maintained automation scripts with Ruby on Rails.
Participated in Agile sprints, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
Created user story tests with Gherkin and Cucumber.

projects.name: Career Intelligence Copilot
projects.summary: Enables an AI Engineering job seeker to decide which roles deserve effort. Reviews job ads against a structured career profile, ranks fit, recommends application strategy, and drafts tailored CVs for human review — reducing repetitive search work while keeping decisions explainable.
outcomes: Delivers an explainable job-intelligence loop from profile through strategy and tailored CV drafts under owner review.
Uses golden validation suites and formal GO / NO-GO close-out for release-quality engineering decisions.
demonstrates: Golden validation suites with GO / NO-GO release gates

projects.name: Operational Intelligence Copilot
projects.summary: Demonstrates operational intelligence capability for understanding business data. Combines reliable analytics with AI reasoning to surface anomalies and produce clear, evidence-backed executive insights that can be checked and trusted.
outcomes: Maintains decision traceability through explainable recommendations.

projects.name: Governance-Aware Document Intelligence RAG
projects.summary: Allows organisations to answer questions from their own documents with responses that stay grounded in source material. Built for teams that need trustworthy AI answers over policies, procedures, and knowledge bases — with evaluation and explainability controls.
outcomes: Supports grounded responses over multi-format organisational documents.
Provides evaluation, telemetry, and explainability controls.

projects.name: Payroll Diagnostics Engine
projects.summary: Reviews payroll data against deterministic business rules to identify anomalies. Produces explainable findings and executive-ready reports so issues can be investigated with confidence.

projects.name: Public Holiday Entitlements Application
projects.summary: Determines Australian public-holiday entitlements from location and rules for HR and payroll teams. Combines geospatial logic with external APIs to produce compliance-oriented results.
outcomes: Determines Australian public-holiday entitlements from location and rules.

selected_engineering_highlights: Designed and delivered a portfolio of AI applications combining deterministic logic with AI reasoning across RAG, operational intelligence, diagnostics, entitlements, and career decision support.
Built modular service architectures with FastAPI, containerised services with Docker, and unit/regression suites in PyTest.
Designed explainable, evidence-backed recommendation flows with traceable outputs rather than opaque model responses.
Published architecture notes, testing approach, and working demonstrations through a public portfolio and GitHub repositories.

engineering_methodology.philosophy: Applies AI to improve engineering quality and delivery discipline, not to replace engineering judgement.

goals.primary: Secure a suitable AI Engineering role sooner.
goals.horizon_notes: Horizon 1 takes priority when objectives compete.

must_haves: Role scope involving applied AI Engineering.
